officialSendingAgency.name: The Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad (CEC)

evidenceNotes: Kyrgyzstan's official overseas-employment center explicitly identifies the 2026 EPS-TOPIK recruitment as employment in Korea in the Manufacturing sector.
The local official Manufacturing registration window 2026-02-23 through 2026-02-27 matches HRD Korea's 13th Point System city schedules for Bishkek and Osh.
Official local guidance verifies a US$28 exam fee, Gmail, a recent 3.5×4.5 cm white-background JPG photo, passport-copy JPG and payment-receipt image.
HRD Korea city schedules record test announcement 2026-03-30; Bishkek tests 2026-04-10 through 2026-04-16 and Osh 2026-04-18 through 2026-04-19.
Local official guidance states test passage does not guarantee a contract, successful candidates enter the roster for two years, and employers independently select candidates.
A later 2026 additional/general test and 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK exist but remain separate evidence layers and never overwrite the 13th Manufacturing route.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad / HRD Korea
stages.action: Use the current Kyrgyzstan Manufacturing notice and official EPS rules. Cycle-specific exact eligibility beyond the verified registration notice remains current-notice dependent.

stages.title: 13th Point System Manufacturing registration
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad / HRD Korea
stages.action: The official Kyrgyzstan Manufacturing registration period was 2026-02-23 through 2026-02-27. The window is closed.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK examination fee
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: The official 2026 Manufacturing notice states an examination fee of US$28, payable through the designated Eldik/RSK Bank channel.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: Use passport identity data exactly as required by the current official registration instructions. Duplicate applications are canceled.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: The official online-registration instructions require Gmail, a recent 3.5×4.5 cm white-background JPG photo, passport-copy JPG, and an image of the US$28 payment receipt. Files must be clear/readable and the receipt must be kept for test day.

stages.title: Test announcement / admission
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: HRD Korea records 2026-03-30 as the test-announcement date for the 13th Point System city tracks. Use official individual admission instructions.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — 13th Point System Manufacturing
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: Manufacturing sector linkage is cross-source verified. HRD Korea records Bishkek testing 2026-04-10 through 2026-04-16 and Osh testing 2026-04-18 through 2026-04-19; both are General CBT Point System.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: The local official source confirms Round 1 completion and a preliminary Round 2 Skills Test plan around 2026-05-31 in Bishkek. KEP does not promote a final skills schedule/result until a direct current-cycle artifact is verified.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: Do not infer final selection from Round 1 completion. A current 13th Manufacturing final-result artifact must be reviewed before promotion.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: No separate Kyrgyzstan psychology stage is asserted from the verified 2026 Manufacturing evidence.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad / authorized provider
stages.action: Use only current Kyrgyzstan EPS medical/provider guidance. Exact post-selection provider, checklist and fee remain HOLD.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad / HRD Korea
stages.action: After verified final selection, follow current Kyrgyzstan job-application instructions. Exact 2026 post-selection documents and timing remain HOLD.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad / HRD Korea
stages.action: The official Kyrgyz registration guidance states successful testers enter a unified candidate roster for two years; passing the test does not guarantee a contract, and the Korean employer independently selects candidates.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.authority: Korean employer / EPS
stages.action: The official Kyrgyz guidance states employers independently select candidates; individuals, legal entities or officials cannot influence contract selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: If selected, follow current official Kyrgyzstan/EPS instructions for SLC review/signing.

stages.title: Post-SLC Kyrgyzstan requirements
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: Follow current official instructions for medical follow-up, training, visa, payments and departure.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad / Korean mission
stages.action: Use the current Kyrgyzstan/Korean-mission visa checklist and fees. Exact 2026 downstream details remain HOLD.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: Complete only official pre-departure training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage; follow current Kyrgyzstan instructions if a final health recheck is required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.authority: Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad / HRD Korea
stages.action: Travel only after contract, visa, training and official departure requirements are complete.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.authority: HRD Korea / employment training institution
stages.action: After entry, complete official Korea-side employment education and handover.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.authority: Employment training institution / employer
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.authority: Korea Immigration Service
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.authority: HRD Korea EPS / employer / worker
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.authority: Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for wage or labor issues.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.authority: MOEL employment center / EPS
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process.
